data.comparison: Eligibility is recomputed from the whole executed pool on fixed R0, protein frame, 25 common-valid candidates per arm. Pool condition minimum is 1.9027957 A ([7,5,5,5]); band edge = 1.9227957 A. Inside it the functional leaders are [1,3,7,5] gap 3.2016995 at 1.9194755 A, [1,3,5,5] gap 3.2017237 at 1.9197056 A, and [1,7,3,7] gap 3.2018296 at 1.9183036 A; the interval-0=3 cluster is ~3.2185, so the interval-0=1 family leads by ~0.0168 gap units. Leader condition margin is ~0.0033 A, so it remains eligible while the pool minimum stays >=1.89948 A. The interval-0 response is non-monotone: 5->3 gave -0.02924 gap/-0.00041 A; 3->1 gave -0.0168/+0.00093 A; 3->2 cost +0.00176/-0.00130 A; and the measured 1->0 step on [*,3,5,5] reversed to +0.00698 gap/+0.00751 A and left the band (3.2087/1.9272 A). Thus tick 1 is the measured useful endpoint and tick 0 is a regime risk, not a smooth continuation. Intervals 1, 2 and 3 are null at measured +/-2-tick edges; interval-3 gain is only a small condition lever (-0.000647 A at +0.000093 gap). Best is flat/tail-driven (teacher 7.4122; pool best ~7.224; top10 5.31-5.44) and never displaces in-band mean gap. This final allocation ranks G2:H1 first for the largest forecast gain, then G3:H1 as the direct leader-background zero test, G4:H2 and G1:H2 as tick-1-preserving near-leader/transfer arms. G3:H2 and G4:H1 are higher-variance zero-endpoint alternatives but add the same unverified extension rather than diversity; brackets G1:H1 and G2:H2 are predicted to trail and are ranked last. The selected set is not independent protection against the zero-endpoint regime switch; G4:H2 and G1:H2 preserve the known tick-1 regime.
data.failure_directions: If [0,7,3,7] and [0,3,7,5] both land at or above 3.2017 gap or outside 1.9227957 A, the zero-endpoint extension is rejected on these backgrounds and the tick-1 leaders [1,3,7,5]/[1,3,5,5] remain retained without a new slot. A single zero-arm success would be a new in-band leader but still candidate-concentrated; it would not establish a general zero-guidance optimum. If G4:H2 [1,3,6,5] ties ~3.2017, the interval-2=6 background is inert and the leader replicates; if it separates from G4:H1, interval-2=6 is not inert or the joint effect is non-additive. If G1:H2 [1,5,5,5] ties ~3.2017, the interval-1 null transfers to the leader background; a move beyond ~0.001 gap or 0.001 A would indicate interaction. A zero-arm condition above 1.9227957 A is evicted regardless of gap. If any arm lowers the pool minimum below 1.89948 A, recompute the whole-pool band before declaring a leader; do not drop a worse-gap eligible arm to improve a mean.

learning_update.intervention: Tabulated best pic50 across all executed arms and checked whether it varies smoothly with interval-0 amplitude or jumps between clusters.
learning_update.revision: Best is driven by which single candidate happens to be maximal and jumps in ~0.07-wide identity clusters rather than tracking amplitude, so it is not a smooth response variable; only the in-band mean gap should decide between near-tied schedules.
learning_update.next_action: Keep priority on in-band mean gap and condition eligibility; do not reject H1 or H2 on a Best-side drop alone, and do not present a Best gain as an improvement if the in-band mean gap regresses.
learning_update.applicability: This teacher, this 25-candidate population and these schedules; the clustering is a fixed-population observation and is not a claim about new starting populations.
learning_update.alternative_explanation: The clusters could reflect schedule-dependent chemistry (which ligand pose is scored highest) rather than identity; distinguishing them would need per-candidate score records rather than pooled summaries.

data.parent_policy: Every proposal restarts the same new R0 before update 10. Incumbent is output only.

action_contract.double_tick_rule: Two ticks allowed by default; three only in verified_large_step_directions.
action_contract.range_probe_rule: Only after range expansion; at most one of final four. Max two changed intervals. Fine grid remains 0.1. Explain actual jump vs coarse default; all other proposals are local.
action_contract.reference_semantics: Action deltas use this current group anchor. Fixed R0 before update 10 is the physical restart only. Historical causal comparisons do not replace the action anchor.
